page.overview:
Who is Alind Dyfelle?

Alind Dyfelle is a legendary and historical Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah, in fact when Bera and Kiruna find themselves confronted with Cadsuane Melaidhrin, Merana thinks that it must be like herself meeting Alind Dyfelle, Sevlana Meseau or Mabriam en Shereed.
